Name: Configurable Machines
Author: knockedmallard42
Description:
Finally!  You can have a Seed Maker that doesn't ever give you just one seed. :)

Here's a mod that allows you to pick how many products any of the machines give, not just the seed maker.  This [b]doesn't [/b]let you config the inputs, just the outputs.

This mod should be compatible with almost every mod out there.  *fingers crossed*

Uses SMAPI 1.14+

[size=4]How to Configure Machine Output:
[/size]The default config file will generate when you load the mod the first time.  The values in this file may be changed to whatever you'd like.  If it is a value that says "Minimum" or "Maximum" then the mod will randomly generate a number between these two values (keep them as whole numbers).  If the value says "Increase" then the mod will increase the output by the number that you designate.  "Chance" values are percents as decimals (if you want a 25% chance, then put 0.25 as the value).

Manifest.Name: Configurable Machines
